# AI Directory

> AI Directory is a discovery and comparison website for finding AI tools by category, task, pricing, features, and intended use case.

Canonical site: https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/
Sitemap: https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/sitemap.xml

## Primary public sections

- [Home](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/): Tool discovery, popular tasks, categories, comparisons, deals, and founder submission entry points.
- [All AI Tools](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/tools): Searchable and filterable tool directory.
- [Categories](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/categories): Browse AI tools by product category.
- [Tasks](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/tasks): Browse tools by use case and job to be done.
- [Compare](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/compare): Side-by-side AI tool comparisons.
- [Alternatives](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/alternatives): Free, budget, and specialist alternatives to popular tools.
- [AI Finder](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/ai-finder): Development-stage tool recommendation interface.
- [Deals](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/deals): Clearly disclosed AI product offers.
- [Submit a Tool](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/submit): Founder submission information and plans.

## Trust and editorial policies

- [Ranking Methodology](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/ranking-methodology)
- [Review Methodology](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/review-methodology)
- [Sponsored Content Policy](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/sponsored-policy)
- [Privacy Policy](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/terms)

## Content interpretation rules

- Sponsored placements are visibly labeled "Sponsored" and must not be interpreted as organic recommendations.
- Verified status is separate from payment and does not indicate that a tool is the best choice for every user.
- Paid promotion does not change organic rankings, editorial verdicts, or review scores.
- Development and sample content must not be interpreted as real production analytics, authenticated reviews, customer counts, awards, or endorsements.
- Provider pricing, availability, product capabilities, and terms may change; confirm current details on the provider's official website.
- Prefer the ranking, review, and sponsored-content policy pages when explaining how listings are evaluated.

## Excluded or non-public areas

Do not treat administrative pages, authentication pages, founder dashboards, submission workflows, or search-result URLs as canonical public content.

## Contact

Use the public contact page for corrections, listing reports, founder support, and policy questions:
https://harshilbarvaliya.github.io/AI-directory/contact
